language.label: Language
language.hint: The language of the app's screens. "Auto" follows your device's language. The display language inside columns (x.com) follows your X settings.

popup.title: Popup windows
popup.image: Open images in a popup window
popup.video: Open videos in a popup window

ngWords.title: Global muted words
ngWords.helpRegex: Entering /pattern/flags treats it as a regular expression (case-insensitive).
ngWords.placeholder: One word per line (applies to all columns; /regex/flags is also accepted)
ngWords.hint: Applies to the timelines of all columns, together with each column's own muted words.

repostHidden.title: Users whose reposts are hidden
repostHidden.placeholder: One user ID per line (applies to all columns)
repostHidden.hint: One user ID per line (the part after @). Posts reposted by these users are hidden.

android.useXApp: Launch the X app with the post button
android.multiColumn: Show multiple columns on wide screens (tablet / landscape)
android.columnCount: Number of columns shown at once

uiScale.label: App UI display size
uiScale.override: Change the app UI display size
uiScale.hint: The size of the app's own screens (toolbar, settings, etc.). Change the size of column contents with "Display size inside columns".

columnScale.label: Display size inside columns
columnScale.override: Change the display size inside columns
columnScale.hint: The size of content inside columns (the x.com display).

display.title: Column defaults - Display
display.restoreScroll: Restore the scroll position after viewing photos

customCss.title: Column defaults - Custom CSS
customCss.hint: Applies to columns you add from now on.

layout.pendingHint: Click to place at column {{col}}, row {{row}}

officialSettings.title: Official settings
officialSettings.hint: Opens X's official settings in a popup window. From there you can apply settings to your other accounts.

webview.title: WebView
webview.hint: Recreates the WebView of every column in turn. Your settings are kept.

dataDir.title: Delete data folders
dataDir.pending_one: {{count}} data folder could not be deleted
dataDir.pending_other: {{count}} data folders could not be deleted
dataDir.remaining_one: {{count}} data folder could not be deleted
dataDir.remaining_other: {{count}} data folders could not be deleted

linuxVideo.title: Video playback (Linux)
linuxVideo.enableHint: Gets the decoder needed to play videos.

extensions.addNote: Specify an unpacked extension folder, or pick from extensions already installed in Chrome / Edge, to add them to all accounts.

storagePath.location: Extensions for Chromium-based browsers are usually located at %LOCALAPPDATA%\{organization}\{browser}\User Data\Default\Extensions\<extension ID>\<version> (some browsers have no organization folder).
storagePath.example: Example: Chrome is at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Extensions, and Edge is at %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default\Extensions.
storagePath.others: Chrome and Edge are found automatically with "Detect from browser". For other browsers such as Brave, specify a version folder in the format above with "Add from folder". If you have changed the user data location, specify the User Data\Default\Extensions folder under that location.

extensions.trustNotice: Added extensions may be able to read and modify X pages for all accounts. Only add extensions you trust.
extensions.unsupportedNotice: Some extensions may not work correctly. In particular, extensions that detect the content of the open page and are used from a toolbar button may not work, because their popups open in a separate window.
extensions.reloadNotice: Adding, removing, or enabling/disabling extensions automatically reloads all columns.

backup.noCredentials: This backup does not include login information. Log in on the destination beforehand.
backup.exportPrivacy: Backup files contain personal information such as account names, muted words, and users whose reposts are hidden. Be careful when sharing or storing them.
backup.reauthHint: Accounts without a known X user ID can't be matched automatically. Re-authenticate those accounts to enable automatic suggestions.
backup.saveBlocked: Settings could not be loaded, so loading and restoring backups is unavailable. Please restart the app.
backup.replaceWarning: All current columns and settings (except window position) will be replaced with the backup contents. Accounts are not replaced. Your settings just before restoring are backed up automatically.

export.title: Create a backup
export.note: Exports account info (names and colors), column layout, and settings to a single file.

mapping.title: Link accounts
mapping.note: For each account in the backup, choose a logged-in account to restore to. Columns of accounts set to "Don't restore" will not be restored.
mapping.noTargets: There are no logged-in accounts to restore to. Add an account first.
mapping.shared: Multiple accounts in the backup are assigned to the same destination ({{names}}). Check that this is intended.
mapping.none: Nothing is linked, so nothing can be restored. Choose at least one destination.
